observations.finding: The epilogue writes each split FP32 accumulator through a BF16 output pointer; line 514 rounds to BF16 before any cross-split reduction.
The reduction reads BF16 partials, sums them in FP32, then converts the final sum to BF16. FP32 summation cannot recover prior partial rounding.
API and OutputPTR currently type the partial workspace as BF16.
The bridge casts the workspace to BF16; changing only the reducer is insufficient.

hypothesis: An isolated split-K prototype retaining partials in FP32 could remove extra partial rounding while preserving the MMA inner loop. Changed summation order still requires unchanged numerical qualification.
required_changes: Separate or explicitly version the workspace ABI and use FP32 element sizes throughout allocation and offsets.
Preserve split1 behavior and output dtype; validate bounds, canaries, graph replay and lifetimes.
Retain the prior split-K numerical failures and stricter original diagnostic thresholds; do not substitute the weaker dense-output screen.
Preserve licensed source notices externally and record any adaptation in CONTRIBUTING before implementation.
